turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have about twenty minutes, Hale, and I'd like to know why my son's mark was changed to a zero before anyone called me.
You didn't answer my question. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen asked a single thing before it went in?
Can you read me your notes word for word?

I'll read you one line. "Procedure 4.2: parent contacted before any mark is entered. Nobody called me. Owen saw it on his phone in class." The rest is mine, Hale, and you'll have my position in writing. Now, who decided?
Not those notes. Your instructions. What were you told to do in this meeting?
I wasn't told anything, Hale. I came here on my own, and I have a client call in under twenty minutes. Who decided on the zero?
What do you plan to say if I bring up your daughter?
I don't plan anything about my daughter, because she isn't part of this meeting. If you bring her up, you'll want to be very careful about the sentence that follows. Who decided on the zero?
